content.enriched_brief: Create an urban crime-suspense animated short drama. The protagonist is a suspense male lead, a man with a distinctive scar and often wet hair, reflecting the perpetually rainy city streets at night, illuminated by neon signs and streetlights, where he operates. As the new deputy captain of the homicide unit, he takes on his very first case: a serial-disposal cold case that has been silent for fifteen years. As he relentlessly closes in on the truth, he uncovers a shocking revelation, finding his own father's name plainly listed among the original suspects. The animation should include Chinese subtitles for short-video platform distribution.
